description:
Create PySparkSQLAdapter extending PlatformAdapter base class.
Implements all required abstract methods for SQL benchmark execution.

This adapter enables running TPC-H/TPC-DS benchmarks via Spark SQL syntax,
complementing the existing DataFrame adapter for a dual-mode platform.

Required abstract method implementations:
| Method | Implementation |
|--------|----------------|
| create_connection() | Return SparkSession from shared manager |
| create_schema() | Execute translated CREATE TABLE statements |
| load_data() | Read files -> DataFrame -> saveAsTable() |
| execute_query() | spark.sql(query).collect() with timing |
| get_target_dialect() | Return "spark" |
| configure_for_benchmark() | Set OLAP optimizations |
